seoTitle: FilmEditRun | Corporate Video Production Cambridge & London
seoDescription: From conference stages to corporate boardrooms. We film live events, executive interviews, and brand stories across Cambridge, London, and nationwide.
heroHeadingPrefix: Capture the room. Cut the story.
tagline: From conference stages to corporate boardrooms. We film live events, executive interviews, and brand stories across Cambridge, London, and nationwide.
introBody: Working alongside corporate brands, event organisers, and creative agencies, we produce films that feel authentic and alive. With quiet discretion so your speakers feel at ease, we turn real energy and complex ideas into films that connect.

telemetryMetrics.label: Years On-Location
telemetryMetrics.description: Over a decade of commercial filming, live conference stages, and post-production craft.

telemetryMetrics.label: Creative Event Wrap-Ups
telemetryMetrics.description: Polished wrap-up edits and speaker soundbites delivered while your event is still trending.

telemetryMetrics.label: Operational Hubs
telemetryMetrics.description: Cambridge studio base and London on-location field crews filming UK-wide.

telemetryMetrics.label: Widescreen & Social Cutdowns
telemetryMetrics.description: Full-length masters for your website, plus captioned vertical and square cutdowns built for social feeds.

workSpotlightDescription: Watch our archive of recent conference keynotes, brand stories, and fast-turnaround social edits delivered across the UK.
scaleHeading: Driven by the task. *Not the tool.*
scaleDescription: High-spec production technology is only as effective as the intention behind it. From multi-camera live coverage to cinema optics, we configure our setup around the specific demands of your brief, ensuring the technology serves the task and delivers the right result.
bentoDescription: Modular filming, post-production, and motion capabilities built for corporate brands and live events. From multi-camera conference stages and executive interviews to bespoke motion design and rapid-turnaround edits.
pipelineDescription: A disciplined four-stage process that removes friction regardless of location, protects your schedule, and ensures technical precision from concept to delivery.
hubsDescription: Operating from our Cambridge studio base, with agile field units deployed across London and nationwide. Single-source production designed for fast turnaround and seamless delivery.
ctaHeading: Have an upcoming project *or live event?*
ctaDescription: Whether you have a finalized brief or an early date in mind, we're ready to collaborate. Tell us about your venue, goals, or timeline. We'll deliver a clear technical production scope and transparent quote within 24 hours.
